chunks: If they try to deceive you, remember they have deceived God before. So He gave you mastery over them, for God is all-knowing and all-wise.

key_terms.خَانُوا اللَّهَ: They deceived God (by violating His covenant/command)
key_terms.خِيَانَتَكَ: Deception or treachery directed at you

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the hypocrites deceiving the Prophet and God's response?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as addressing both the Banu Nadir and the Hypocrites (Munafiqun), highlighting that their betrayal of the Prophet was essentially a betrayal of Divine authority, thereby justifying God's granting of victory. The phrase 'Allah enabled [you] over them' is seen as a divine facilitation of military or political dominance, underscoring that human treachery ultimately serves God's wisdom. This reinforces the concept that the Prophet's authority is an extension of Divine will, making his enemies' deceit self-defeating.
